title: Stitch Lint
summary: Command line tool that checks knitting patterns for stitch count mistakes.

data.text: Knitting patterns are tiny programs, and they have bugs. Stitch Lint parses a written pattern, counts stitches row by row, and flags any row where the numbers do not add up.

data.code:
$ stitch-lint scarf.txt
row 14: expected 42 stitches, pattern gives 41
  hint: "k2tog" twice in the repeat, but only one "yo"

data.text: It started as a way to learn Rust and ended up in a few knitting forums, which is still the most surprising user group Odile has had.
